discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.9.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/section_18.9/cis_18.9.25.8.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value is the value backed by the following registry REG_DWORD value of 3 or 5. Use this setting to specify the actions to take upon expiration of the configured grace period. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled: Reset the password and logoff the managed account or higher. 3 - Reset the password and logoff the managed account 5 - Reset the password and reboot the device
odvs.name: laps_postauthenticationactions_value

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.9.25.8 | PATCH | Ensure Post-authentication actions: Actions is set to Enabled: Reset the password and logoff the managed account or higher"
  when:
    - win25cis_rule_18_9_25_8
    - prelim_win25cis_is_domain_member
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_18.9.25.8
    - patch
    - laps
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "18.9.25.8 | PATCH | Ensure Post-authentication actions: Actions is set to Enabled: Reset the password and logoff the managed account or higher | Set Variable"
      when: win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value == 3 or win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value == 5
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\LAPS
        name: PostAuthenticationActions
        data: "{{ win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "18.9.25.8 | AUDIT | Ensure Post-authentication actions: Actions is set to Enabled: Reset the password and logoff the managed account or higher | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when:
        - win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value != 3
        - win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value != 5
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid setting for win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "18.9.25.8 | AUDIT | Ensure Post-authentication actions: Actions is set to Enabled: Reset the password and logoff the managed account or higher | Log a warning"
      when:
        - win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value != 3
        - win25cis_laps_postauthenticationactions_value != 5
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.9.25.8'
